source_provenance.archive_policy: preserve source unchanged; this artifact is a derived scientific reinterpretation
source_provenance.source_core_reused: checkpoint -> action -> outcome check -> rollback -> alternate attempt

kept: return to an exact prior state after a failed attempt
multiple attempts from the same preserved state
continue only after an accepted outcome
removed_as_non_scientific: post-hoc choice of the best-looking result
semantic_rewrite.replacement: attempt only preregistered exact morphs; accept only independently replayed certificates; otherwise rollback byte-identically and continue the frozen catalog or return OPEN

state_model.semantic_object: exact joint boundary relation R(B)=exists_U C(B,U)
state_model.checkpoint_identity: cryptographic hash over canonical serialization of semantic input + representation + provenance authority
state_model.meaning_invariant: every committed morph must preserve the frozen claim-scoped relation exactly

create_when: after each independently certified successful morph
checkpoint_contract.rollback_requirement: restored checkpoint must be byte-identical in canonical serialization and hash-equal before another morph is attempted

frozen_morph_catalog.selection_rule: deterministic preregistered order; no score, ranking, ML, randomization or success-conditioned reordering
frozen_morph_catalog.catalog_change_policy: requires a new preregistration child; never mutate catalog during a run

attempt_protocol.action: freeze checkpoint C_t and append its hash to ledger
take next unused morph in frozen deterministic catalog whose syntactic/provenance trigger is exactly satisfied
construct candidate carrier M' without SAT/assignment enumeration unless explicitly allowed only in an independent bounded control
independent checker validates trigger, certificate, relation preservation, provenance and resource accounting

attempt_protocol.on_accept: commit M', create new checkpoint, continue pipeline
attempt_protocol.on_fail: append failure receipt, restore C_t byte-identically, mark morph exhausted

conditions: certified terminal SAT/UNSAT under authorized semantics

forbidden: morph ordering changed by observed success
acceptance by smaller size without equivalence proof
full live-boundary cube enumeration in candidate
rewriting checkpoints after observing downstream results
allowed: independent small exhaustive controls that have zero candidate authority

resource_contract.universal_goal: for arbitrary instances, the total discovery+morph+verify+rollback path must be polynomial before any claim of SAT in P
resource_contract.finite_pass_firewall: small finite success or bounded catalog success is not an asymptotic theorem

ledger_contract.law: a new PASS cannot erase an old FAIL

gate_integration.APMA_SS_role: control representation search across multiple exact morphs while preserving one frozen semantic checkpoint
gate_integration.primary_test: C023/C034 reduction images where reverse provenance may expose a tractable source language
positive_controls: dense positive triples -> reverse/source recognition and/or AT_MOST_2
negative_controls: missing complete-hypergraph edge rejected by cardinality morph
gate_integration.killer_control: a failed earlier morph followed by a later valid morph must end in exactly the same certified semantics as running the later valid morph directly from the original checkpoint

captain_obvious.principle: save the exact meaning, not a lucky answer
captain_obvious.question: can APMA try a different exact representation after failure without changing the problem it is solving?
captain_obvious.required_answer: yes, only if rollback restores the identical semantic checkpoint and every alternative morph is independently certified

next_action: archive source and APMA-SS before preregistration; then freeze and run the provenance-preserving tractable escape gate
